tool_args.rationale: Fit the numerically parameterized basin field and compare modest gradient-dependent siphon corrections by leave-one-out error. The independent confirmation will determine whether this smooth approximation meets the 0.045 RMSE tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observations vary strongly with gradient at comparable input levels, which this input-only curve cannot explain.
The verified basin mechanism directly accounts for both concavity and a saturating gradient sink.
Nine paid rows are available at the target horizon; confirmation is more informative than another trajectory batch, and the nuisance probe is irrelevant.
